= Where Hypatia.Kyaml differs from kyq, and why

`Hypatia.Kyaml` differs from kyq's reference parser (`conformance/src/kyaml.js`
at `4d1071df04d93e089500d58d0b6ba37bfcc75248`) only where kyq has a bug. Each one has a
fix for kyq, with conformance fixtures; kyq's suite passes 377 of 377 with it.
Delete a row when kyq carries the fix, and move `KYQ_REF` in
`.github/workflows/ci.yml` past it. The differential test lists the one
divergence its corpus run can meet (`@known_divergences`); the corpus test
lists the fixture it reads differently (`@accepted_divergences`).

[cols="2,3,2",options="header"]
|===
| Case | kyq at the pinned commit | Hypatia.Kyaml (and the kyq fix)

| A stream that starts with a byte order mark
| Refused: `BOM_MIDSTREAM` at 1:1. The leading BOM is skipped, then found again
  by `text.includes("﻿")`.
| Accepted. A BOM after the first character is still `BOM_MIDSTREAM`.
  Fixtures `valid/leading-bom.yaml`, `invalid/bom-midstream.yaml`.

| A comment after a block scalar header: `run: \| # note`
| Refused: `BAD_BLOCK_SCALAR` at 2:2. The comment consumes the header line
  break, then one more character is consumed.
| Accepted (YAML 1.2 §8.1.1). Fixture `valid/block-scalar-header-comment.yaml`.

| The column of `INVALID_NEWLINE` or `BOM_MIDSTREAM` after a character outside
  the BMP
| One too far: `locationOf` walks UTF-16 code units.
| Code points, as every other kyq location. Fixture
  `invalid/bare-cr-after-astral.yaml` (1:5).

| A trailing comma in a flow collection: `ports: [80, 443,]`
| Refused: `FLOW_TRAILING_COMMA`, by kyq's spec (KYAML_SPEC §4).
| Accepted. YAML 1.2 allows it, KYAML as Kubernetes writes it (KEP-5295,
  `kubectl`/`yq -o kyaml`) ends every entry with one, and the estate's KYAML
  directive says "trailing commas OK". kyq's refusal made it refuse canonical
  KYAML: `test/kyaml_workflow_test.exs`, whose fixtures are yq's literal output,
  could not be read. kyq's `invalid/flow-trailing-comma.yaml` becomes valid.

| A raw C0 control character (not a tab) in a plain or block scalar
| Accepted, though it is not printable YAML. kyq refuses one only in a quoted
  scalar (`CONTROL_CHARACTER`).
| Refused with the same code. Found by Codex review of
  hyperpolymath/hypatia#1008; fixed upstream on the same local kyq branch.
  Superseded by the printable-set row below, which checks the whole stream.

| Thirteen YAML 1.2 rules, found by CodeRabbit and Codex review of
  hyperpolymath/hypatia#1008: a second anchor or tag on one node; a decorated
  alias in flow context; a property on a mapping key (`!!str a: 1`); a plain
  scalar starting with an indicator (`@`, `` ` ``, `%`, or `- `, `? `, `: `);
  a `? ` key in a flow mapping; an empty flow entry (`[1,,2]`, `[,]`); an alias
  to an earlier document's anchor; a comment after `%YAML 1.2`; `|2-` header order;
  `!!float 1`; a tab before `#`; spaces past an explicit indentation on a blank
  line; a whole-input column after a leading BOM
| Each read otherwise than YAML 1.2 reads it (the first seven accepted, the next
  three refused, the last three misread).
| As YAML 1.2, with the codes `DUPLICATE_PROPERTY`, `ALIAS_DECORATED`,
  `KEY_PROPERTY`, `PLAIN_INDICATOR`, `UNSUPPORTED_COMPLEX_KEY`, `EMPTY_VALUE` and
  `UNKNOWN_ANCHOR`.
  `test/kyaml_test.exs` holds each case to the result of kyq's bridge vector
  of the same name on the kyq fix.

| The YAML test suite (yaml/yaml-test-suite at `6ad3d2c6`): run against both
  readers, 17 invalid cases parsed and 6 valid ones read wrongly. The rules: a
  `#` needs white space before it to start a comment; comment text may hold no
  control character; a leading blank line of a block scalar may not be
  indented past its content; a folded line starting with a tab is not folded;
  directives may precede each document after `...`, need a `---`, and `%YAML`
  appears once; a final `---` is a null document; a flow collection's lines
  are indented past the block holding it (a closer may sit at its column), use
  no tab as indentation, and hold no document marker; an implicit flow key is
  one line; a flow plain scalar ends at `[` and `{` and holds a `:` before a
  safe character (`{http://x: 1}`); a plain scalar cannot start with `,`, `]`
  or `}`; a tab cannot indent a compact nested collection (`-\t- a`)
| kyq at the pinned commit: 21 invalid cases accepted, 11 valid ones misread
  (the rows above already fixed 4 and 5 of them).
| None accepted and none misread, in both readers, which agree on all 402
  cases. New codes `BAD_COMMENT`, `DUPLICATE_DIRECTIVE`, `MULTILINE_KEY`; the
  others reuse `CONTROL_CHARACTER`, `BAD_BLOCK_SCALAR`, `MISSING_DOC_START`,
  `UNSUPPORTED_DIRECTIVE`, `BAD_INDENT`, `TAB_INDENT`, `UNTERMINATED_FLOW`,
  `FLOW_SEPARATOR` and `PLAIN_INDICATOR`. `test/kyaml_yaml_test_suite_test.exs`
  holds the port to the suite in CI, so a case this table misses still fails
  the build.

| Five rules from Codex review of 6c5d4d0 (hyperpolymath/hypatia#1008): a
  character outside YAML's printable set (`c-printable`) anywhere, not only in
  a scalar or comment, as a directive comment, an anchor name, DEL or a C1
  control; an anchor or tag run into its node (`&a[1]`); a no-break space
  trimmed from a flow key; a `#` after white space inside a flow key; an
  explicit indentation indicator at the document root (`|2`)
| The first four accepted or misread; the last read `"  text"` one column
  short after the document root moved to indentation -1.
| Refused or read as YAML 1.2: one up-front check gives `CONTROL_CHARACTER`
  (or `NONCHARACTER` for U+FFFE, U+FFFF) at the character itself, replacing
  the per-scalar and per-comment checks; `PROPERTY_SEPARATION` is new; a flow
  key trims only space and tab and stops at a separated `#`; a root indicator
  counts from column 0. Signed hexadecimal and octal (`-0xFF`) stay strings:
  the Core Schema gives a sign to decimal integers only.

| Three rules from Codex review of 45fafc4: separation by JavaScript's `\s`
  (a no-break space or other Unicode space taken as YAML white space in
  directive fields, before `#`, and in anchor and alias names); no limit on
  an implicit key's length
| `%YAML` + U+00A0 + `1.2` read as `%YAML 1.2`; `a` + U+00A0 + `#b: 1` read
  as a root string; `&x` + U+00A0 read as the anchor `x`; a key of 1025
  characters accepted.
| Separation is space, tab and line break only; an implicit key over 1024
  characters (code points, over the key itself) is `KEY_TOO_LONG`, in block
  and flow. A `...` with no document open stays legal (suite case HWV9).
|===

End of input ends the last line as a line break would: `x: |\n  a` is
`"a\n"`, as the suite reads it (L24T/01, JEF9/02) and as kyq always did. A
review suggested otherwise and was briefly followed; the suite settled it.

The port also carried one bug kyq does not have: a float literal that
overflows with a negative exponent (`999…9e-1`, 400 digits) read as 0.0, where
kyq gives Infinity. It now gives `:infinity` too.

None of these occurs in the estate's block-style workflows, so the
pinned-commit differential agrees on every file but kyq's own
`flow-trailing-comma.yaml`, which it lists. The kyq fix is nine commits on
`metadatastician/kyq` branch
`fix/bom-and-block-scalar-comment` (the leading BOM and block-header comment,
code-point columns, the trailing comma, control characters, the thirteen
rules, the test-suite rules, the printable set, and YAML white space with the
key limit), still to be opened there.
